Tom —

Appreciate the fast turnaround and for sending the bank letter + Companies House excerpt. Quick summary from our side:

- What we need to clear vendor onboarding and release a provisional PO: a clearly signed W-8BEN-E where the signatory is an authorized officer of the legal entity (CFO/Director) OR a notarized letter from the company confirming delegated signing authority for the tax preparer.
- The current PDF shows the preparer + a countersignature. That often triggers a secondary check on our side to validate signatory authority.

To keep things moving this week, two practical options:
1) If your CFO (the authorized officer) can countersign (an e-signature with audit trail on DocuSign) and email confirmation copy, we can push a provisional PO into the queue while payments completes the final verification.
2) Provide a short letter from the company (on letterhead, signed by an officer) stating that the tax preparer is acting as agent and listing the agent's name + firm — that will satisfy our procurement checks.

I've deployed a DocuSign envelope here if that helps: https://app.docusign.com/documents/XYZ-12345 (upload the countersigned W-8BEN-E). If you prefer option 2, send the agent authorization letter and we'll attach to the vendor record.

Cc'ing Monica (payments) so she knows we may ask for a bank-confirmation match if required.

When you reply, please indicate which option you'll take and we can aim to release a provisional PO within 24–48 hours.

Thanks,

Folks —

Thanks for the update, Ben. Quick payment/process note from my side:

- If CFO countersigns via DocuSign and we receive the agent authorization letter, finance can provisionally release a PO with a conditional hold on net-terms until final KYC is confirmed.
- Required checks before we remove the conditional hold: Companies House excerpt to match legal name (we have that), bank letter with account number masked (we have that), plus the agent authorization letter or notarized confirmation.
- If there are treaty-related withholding questions, we should include a clause in the purchase order contract that allows Redwood to withhold the statutory amount pending tax counsel confirmation. That minimizes exposure.

Karthik — could you review the following suggested PO clause for conditional language and sign-off? I pasted a short draft below: "Supplier shall provide final tax signatory evidence within 14 days. Until receipt, Redwood may apply statutory withholding rates; Redwood will reconcile and refund any over-withheld amounts upon receipt of valid tax documentation."

If you approve, I'll attach the payments checklist and trigger a provisional PO today.
